summary.en: A local memory hub for multi-channel AI characters: separate memories per character and client, automatic backups and restore, message inbox/outbox with offline queueing, model-callable memory tools, optional payment entry. Everything stays on the installer's machine.
summary.zh: 多端 AI 角色的本机记忆中枢：按角色和客户端分开记，写入前自动备份、删错能恢复；支持和各端收发消息、离线暂存；模型可直接读写记忆；可选支付入口。所有数据只留在安装者自己的电脑上。

repoDescription: 多端 AI 角色的本机记忆中枢：分开记、能备份恢复、可分端收发、模型可读写、可选支付入口。Local memory hub for multi-channel AI characters.

zh: 记忆：按角色和客户端分开存，互不覆盖；写入前自动备份，删错一条也能恢复。
收发：电脑、手机、QQ 等端之间可以按端发消息；对方离线时先存本地，上线再收；离线期间的记忆能并回正常记忆。
模型接入：安装者自己的 AI 能直接读写记忆；会自动识别本机 AI 服务和主流厂商（OpenAI、Claude、Gemini、DeepSeek、通义、GLM、Kimi 等）以及各自可用模型；也能用日常说话改设置，同一项再改会覆盖，不需要设置按钮。
支付：按金额生成付款入口，只给入口，不接触支付密码或银行卡。
本机运行：自动选择可用端口，数据只存在安装者自己的目录；能接多少端、存多少条由本机资源决定，不写死上限。
隐私：不统计使用情况、不主动联网；收集任何数据前都必须先明确同意。
开关：可随时停用；停用后不启动服务、不写数据，也不影响 AI 正常使用。
en: Memory: separate memories per character and client, so they never overwrite each other; automatic backup before writes, and a mistakenly deleted item can be restored.
Messaging: send between desktop, phone and QQ-style clients; offline messages queue locally and arrive when back online; offline memory can be merged back.

Model integration: the installer's AI reads/writes memory; detects local AI services and major providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, GLM, Kimi and more) with their models; settings can also be changed by talking naturally, overwriting the same key.
Payment: generates a payment entry for a chosen amount; it never touches payment passwords or bank cards.
Local only: picks a free local port automatically, keeps data in the installer's own folder; the number of clients and records is limited only by local resources.
Privacy: no usage statistics and no outbound collection; any collection needs explicit consent first.
Switch: can be disabled at any time; when disabled it starts no service, writes no data and does not affect the AI.
